questions.question: Dr. REDA must train young dentists in dental photography. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: Dental photography is an essential tool for diagnosis and communication
Dental photography is reserved for aestheticians

questions.question: Dr. RACHID must create a training center in dental photography. What is the main objective?
